title_as_printed: Solubility of Krypton and Oxygen - Solvent, Uranyl Sulfate B
footnotes_as_printed: none printed; '...' in a cell means no value given
pressure_note: Total pressure and krypton / oxygen partial pressures in p.s.i.a. (absolute) at the test temperature; Kr tagged with Kr-85 at tracer level, O2 overpressure; partial pressures derived from the vapor-phase sample analysis

value.col: K Krypton, P.S.I.A. per mole fraction x 10^5

value2.col: Mole Fraction O2 in Liquid x 10^-4

value3.col: K Oxygen, P.S.I.A. per mole fraction x 10^5

composition.other_species: uranyl sulfate solution (UO2SO4, with CuSO4 and H2SO4), all out of the six-ion set; concentrations from Table I of the paper (chemical composition, mole/liter); volume basis not stated

conversion_needs: K in psia per mole fraction, so x = p / K for Henry's law; the Kr mole fraction itself is not reported

oxygen mole fraction basis (with or without dissolved Kr, salts) not stated; gas volumes at STP are mentioned only in the text for Figs. 2-4 ('milliliters of krypton at STP per gram of solvent'), STP not defined
